Commentary.Commentary: The hosts will have to bat for around 20 minutes before Dinner is taken. Can the Afghans take some early wickets? They do not have any choice. Stay tuned...

The Windies bowled well at the start but after the 20-over mark, they started to look jaded. The bowling lost sting and allowed the tourists to bat on, when they could have been rolled over quite easily. Gabriel, Holder and Joseph picked up 2 wickets pretty quickly upfront while the spinners Nurse and Chase shared 3 amongst themselves.

The lower order then offered some resistance with Gulbadin Naib's 51 stretching them to 135. He tried to play a long innings but ran out of partners. Not the best of batting by the visitors where only four batsmen crossed double figures - Naib, Nabi, Stanikzai and Mr. Extras (15).

The Afghans would have been buoyed by their bowling in the first game and hence there was not much surprise when they chose to bat. They started off cautiously but once the first wicket fell, a procession followed. In next to no time, they slipped from 21/0 to 51/6. The batsmen had no clue to the short pitch bowling and were literally feeling like a cat in front of a headlight.

A much better bowling performance from the Windies. Today, they concentrated on hitting the short length and bamboozled many of the Afghan batsmen. As many as 5 fell to the short ball, 4 of those being snorters.

OUT! Departs immediately after getting to his half century. Nurse tosses this up outside off and Naib looks to go over long off. Does not middle it at all and finds Alzarri Joseph at widish long off. AFGHANISTAN HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 135!
FOUR! Gets hold of this one. A short ball, Naib gets back and pulls this behind square leg for a boundary. 3RD ODI FIFTY for Gulbadin Naib. Good fighting innings.
Full on middle, heaved off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket. No single taken.
Full and around off, Hamza gets across and defends it towards fine leg. Does not take the single.
Full and outside off, hammered down to long on for a single.
Full and down the leg side, GN misses his flick. Gabriel appeals for LBW but that was going down the leg side.

Good fielding effort in the deep. A full toss on middle, Gulbadin swings it to the leg side. First, Roston Chase gets across to his side from deep mid-wicket and stops the ball partially with his right hand and with the momentum, goes beyond the ropes. Then, seeing the ball roll back to the ropes, Jason Mohammed rushes across from deep square leg and dives to prevent the boundary. The umpires refer it upstairs to check but replays show that it is fine. Two runs in the end.
A short ball on middle, Naib goes for the hook but misses.
A short ball, around off, pulled towards deep square leg. Jason Mohammed fumbles, teasing the batsmen for a single but they are not interested.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a run. Not the greatest bit of captaincy from Jason Holder, allowing that easy single to Naib.
Now he flicks it to square leg. Does not take the run again.
Pushes this towards long on. Declines the single.
A length ball outside off, defended to the off side.
AMIR HAMZA is the last man in. How long can Afghanistan bat?

OUT! That is a terrific catch. And that is exactly why the question was asked on the last ball of the previous over. Full and outside off, Dawlat cannot control himself and goes for the big slog. He hits this high in the air but it is a pretty long boundary on the leg side. Evin Lewis keeps his eyes on the ball at the mid-wicket fence, runs to his left and then takes a superb diving catch. He hurts himself and grimaces in pain as Kieran Powell comes across from long on to congratulate him.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single. Why? On the last ball? Bizarre.
WIDE. Gets across and attempts to flick but misses. The ball is down the leg side.
Goes back and heaves it to long on for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Naib misses out. He is hit on the pads. Fine leg was inside the circle.
A length ball on middle, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Scratch that. No one is running.
Full and wide outside off, pushed towards cover.
WIDE. That slips out of the hand and lands outside the pitch. Naib does not even bother to get bat to that.
Almost a yorker on middle, pushed towards long on. No single taken.

SHANNON GABRIEL is back on. Remember, he had gone off the field after bowling just 5.4 overs. He would be looking to finish this off. West Indies have been pretty untidy in the past few minutes. Not trying to finish things off.
Outside off, driven through the covers where a fumble allows the single. No pressure whatsoever.
A short ball on middle and leg, pulled away for a couple again.
On the leg stump, swept pretty fine for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long on. Does not take the single.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Dawlat reaches out and slices it over covers. Just about manages to reach the fence.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
ASHLEY NURSE is back on.
Full and down the leg side, Gulbadin misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Holder appeals but that was going down the leg side.
A short ball outside off, cut through the gap between backward point and short third man for a couple.
Around off, pushed to the leg side.
A short ball outside off, Naib sways away.
A full toss down the leg side, clipped towards fine leg. Does not take the single.
SIX! That is a tremendous shot. A length ball, around off, Naib gets under it and sends it sailing over long on!
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a couple.
Tucks it around the leg side for a run.

WAS THAT A CHANCE? Full and outside off, Dawlat looks to go big over long off but miscues it. Devendra Bishoo, the substitute for Alzarri Joseph covers good ground from long off but cannot get to the ball even with a dive. The batsmen take just a single.
Short and outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
Outside off, pushed to the off side.
FOUR! BLUDGEONED! The shots continue to come. Full and outside off, Naib smashes this straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary. 100 UP FOR AFGHANISTAN!
DAWLAT ZADRAN comes on to bat at number 10, replacing Rashid.

OUT! Gone next ball. Holder persists with his short ball strategy, lands this around off and Rashid goes for the pull. He gets a top edge and the keeper takes it but Rashid cunningly shadow-practises his pull shot. Now Holder appeals and Rashid has to go after the umpire raises his finger. West Indies 2 wickets away now...

TOP EDGE, SIX! Poor Alzarri Joseph is down as well. A short ball around middle, from around the wicket, Rashid goes for the hook but the ball climbs on him and takes the top edge. It goes high, high and high but towards Alzarri Joseph at fine leg. However he takes the catch but beyond the boundary! He tries to push the ball back but cannot do so. In fact, he ends up slipping and losing balance and it is so bad that the physio is tending him.
A short ball outside off, RK looks to play the upper cut but misses.
Excellent yorker around off, dug out to the off side.
A short ball around off, Khan goes for the pull but misses.
On a good length outside off, pushed towards point.
WIDE. Short and down the leg side, Rashid ducks. That is the 11th wide of the innings and 6th by Holder alone. In the previous game, West Indies had bowled just 4 wides overall.
TIME FOR DRINKS.
Flighted on off, Naib drives it to cover.
Bowls it on the stumps, Naib heaves it over the mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Drives it to long on for a run.
Floats it on off, Naib drives it through covers for a run.
Tosses it on off, Naib defends it off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, Naib punches it off the back foot through the off side for a couple.
Length ball, Khan defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it on the pads, Naib flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the keeper.
OUCH! That must have hurt. Short ball, Naib goes for the pull but gets hit on the helmet. He was shaken by that blow as there was a run there which he did not take.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Naib goes for the pull but misses and the umpire calls wide.
Bowls a shorter length, Naib does well to evade it.
Full on off, driven towards mid off.
JASON HOLDER is brought back into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short outside off, Rashid goes for the cut but gets an under edge.
BEATEN! Rashid plays for the turn at the ball outside off but it goes straight off the arm and Rashid is beaten.
Bowls it flatter on the stumps, Rashid rocks onto the back foot and plays it on the leg side.
RASHID KHAN comes out to bat. He is not at all a rabbit with the bat.

OUT! The bowling change works wonders. Chase gets his first ODI wicket. Tosses it on off, the batsman comes down the track and goes to poke at it but gets an outside edge to first slip. Ashley Nurse takes a simple catch. Chase got good purchase from the deck there. He breaks  the partnership between the two batsmen. Afghanistan have lost their 7th wicket with not a lot on the board.
Bowls it on the pads, the batsman flicks it to square leg.
ROSTON CHASE into the attack now.
Length ball on off, Naib defends it off the front foot.
Full ball, Naib drives it off the front foot to mid off.
Bowls it on the pads, Zazai flicks it through square leg for a run. Zazai wanted two but there was never a second there.
Lands it on a length on off, Zazai defends it off the back foot.
He wanted to hit that out of the ground. Powell bowls it on a length. Zazai walks down and goes for a heave over mid-wicket but does not connect.
Full ball on off, Zazai plays it to point.
Comes down the track and drives it mid off.
Bowled on the pads, Naib flicks it behind square leg for a couple.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Drags his length back, Zazai punches it off the back foot through covers for a run.
Bowls it full, Zazai drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter on the stumps, Zazai tucks it on the leg side.
Full ball on the stumps, Zazai drives it down the ground for a run. This is the best partnership of the innings for Afghanistan. These two have added 26 runs for the 7th wicket.
Length ball outside off, Zazai does not play a shot to it.
Angles it onto his pads, Naib flicks it through mid on for a run.
Bowls it full outside off, Zazai drives it through covers where the fielder half stops it and the mid off fielder backs up. They run a single.
Length ball outside off, Zazai pushes it to covers.
Full angling into the pads, Zazai flicks it to the left of fine leg for a couple.
ROVMAN POWELL comes back into the attack.
Floats it on off, Naib defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Bowls it wide outside off, Naib drives it through cover-point for a couple. Zazai wanted three but Naib is not interested.
Bowled on the pads, Zazai flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Tosses it on off, Naib drives it down to long on for a run.
Bowled on off, the batsman defends off the front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
WIDE! This is getting too predictable. Bowls it short again and the umpire signals a wide.
Short again, Zazai ducks under it.
Short and wide outside off, Zazai goes to cut but misses it.

Good take there by the keeper. Drifts on the pads, Zazai tries to flick it fine but misses and it goes off the pads. The keeper dives to his left and collects it well. There is a half appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Lands it on a length on off, Zazai defends it off the back foot to point.
WIDE! Strays down the leg side, Zazai attempts the flick but misses it and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
BEATEN! Bowls it quicker, gets a little turn, Naib goes to push it off the back foot but misses.
Drags his length back, Naib punches it off the back foot.
Flighted ball, Naib defends it covering the line of the ball.
Floats it on off, Naib defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Zazai drives it to long off for a run.
Bowls it outside off, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
Pitches it short on off, Naib pulls it but does not get it out of the middle and the ball falls in the vacant mid-wicket area for a couple.
Length ball on off, Naib punches it to mid off for no run.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Naib defends it off the back foot.
Bowls a bouncer, Naib ducks under it.
SIX! BANG! Naib breaking the shackles. Full ball on the stumps, Naib gets his front foot out of the way and lofts it for a six over the long on fence. They would need a lot more of that from him.
Short outside off, the batsman watches the ball go through to the keeper.
Short and wide outside off, Zazai flashes hard but misses.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
That is a good shot. Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it past the diving fielder at cover for a single.
Full again, another watchful defense on offer. Zazai wants a single but is sent back.
Fuller in length, Naib reaches out and defends it to the off side.
Landed outside off, short in length, spinning in, punched towards short mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Defends this to the leg side.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Zazai gets across and lets it go.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! A short ball around off, AZ fends at it but is unable to adjust to the increasing bounce. The ball goes off the top edge but does not carry to the fielders running in from point and cover.
On a good length around off, Afsar defends watchfully.
A length ball outside off, Zazai looks to drive but misses.
Goes back and works it to the leg side.
Landed outside off, pushed towards point.
Goes back again to turn the ball towards short mid-wicket.
Punches this towards short mid-wicket.
Floats this wide outside off, gets it to spin in, Naib pushes at it and gets a healthy outside edge past slip towards third man. Two runs taken.
Flicks it towards short fine leg for a single.
A slower ball yorker around leg, dug out towards the bowler.
There comes the two-card trick, four short balls followed by a full one and Naib falls for it. Swishes hard, seeing the length but misses it comprehensively.
WIDE. That is way too short and way too high. Naib lets it go and the square leg umpire stretches his arms. Joseph is not happy but that is a wide.
Expects a short ball well in advance and ducks even before the ball arrives. Almost hangs his bat out like a periscope and the ball nearly kisses the wood on its way to the keeper.
GULBADIN NAIB walks in at number 8, replacing Nabi.

OUT! Another short ball consumes an Afghan batsman. Nabi's luck runs out. Another one landed in the area of the bowler, rises steeply, Nabi fends at it feebly and can only spoon it in the air. Roston Chase jogs in a few steps from square leg and takes a comfortable catch. 6 down now and we have not even completed 20 overs. Afghanistan will do very well to reach a competitive score from here.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A short ball around off, Nabi sways away.

EDGED, BUT SAFE! More fortune for Nabi. This one spins in a long way from outside off, Nabi goes back to push at it and gets a thick outside edge. Jason Holder is a bit late and lazy to react at first slip and the ball goes past his left hand. Alzarri Joseph gives it a terrific chase from fine leg and just stops the ball before the ropes. Three runs taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Punches this towards cover.
Pushes this towards long on but the bowler gets across to stop.
Shortish outside off, Nabi looks to cut but misses.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Outside off, played straight to point.
AFZAR ZAZAI walks in at number 7, replacing Stanikzai.

OUT! Caught. This is hostile bowling at its very best. The age-old West Indian style. Frightening young kids from outside the continent with terrifying short bowling. This is right in the middle of the pitch and rises alarmingly. Stanikzai has nowhere to go and just fends it. He has absolutely no idea about when it comes and where it goes. Pops off the top edge, goes straight up in the air and Shai Hope does the rest. Afghanistan are being overawed here with this short stuff.

JUST OVER! Nabi is living dangerously here. Another short of a length delivery outside off, Mohammad flays at it, only to get an outside edge, but luckily for him, over the man at gully to third man! A single taken.
Ooooh... a shorter delivery, Nabi looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge. Does not carry to point.
Landed around off, defended to the off side.
Short and outside off, cut through point where the fielder dives to his right to stop the ball.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Spins in from outside off, punched towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, worked towards squarish mid-wicket for a run.
Landed outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Outside off, punched to long on for a single.
First sign of spin. ASHLEY NURSE into the attack now.
Pushes this towards cover.
A short ball on middle, pulled towards short mid-wicket.
A length ball on middle, flicked towards square leg.
A short ball again, tucked through square leg for a run.
A bouncer around off, Nabi sways out of the way.
Back of a length, down the leg side, helped to fine leg for a single.
He is one of the three pacers today.
ALZARRI JOSEPH comes into the attack.

DRINKS BREAK. Very slow over rate as far as West Indies are concerned. They have got 4 wickets but that cannot be an excuse. Plus, they have got 3 fast bowlers and one spinner. That is not going to help.
A short ball again, Nabi looks to tuck it fine but the ball goes off the glove past the keeper. Two runs taken.
A short ball down the leg side, helped to square leg for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Short and wide outside off, Stanikzai flashes hard but misses.
A short ball around middle and leg, fended to the leg side.
A bouncer on middle, Stanikzai sways his head out of the way.
Short and outside off, slapped behind point for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.

This is not looking too good. SHANNON GABRIEL is not looking comfortable at all and is walking off the field holding his right leg. Hamstring issues again? A massive series against India is coming up. GABRIEL IS WALKING OFF. Rovman Powell to finish his over.
Excellent short ball outside off, Nabi cannot do much than attempt a hook. Misses it totally.
FREE HIT coming up!

NO BALL! "Father of an overstepping," mentions my colleague. It was that big. Gabriel striving for extra pace bowls from what would have been a fuller length for a batsman at the non-striker's end and then lands it on the pads of the batsman at the striker's end. Generates good bounce and Nabi fends it off. But he has to re-bowl it.
Around off, watchfully defended.
This is on the pads and Nabi flicks it through fine leg for a couple.
MOHAMMAD NABI walks in at number 6, replacing Shenwari.

OUT! LBW! Plumb in front! Or is it? Anyways, no review here in the Caribbean and Shenwari has to go. Very fuller in length, around off, Shenwari plays all around it. He misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Gabriel appeals and up goes the umpire's finger. Jeffrey Dujon on air is not too impressed with the decision. Feels it is going down the leg side.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Just over the keeper. Bowls a well-directed short ball. The batsman goes for the pull but gets a top edge over the keeper for a boundary.
Back of a length ball, Stanikzai defends it off the back foot.
Shorter length on the pads, Stanikzai is cramped for room and gets hit on the thigh pads. The ball rolls on the leg side.
Bowls it on the pads, Stanikzai goes to flick but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Full ball outside off, Stanikzai slaps it past mid off for a boundary. The first one for the skipper.
Full ball on the pads, Shenwari flicks it to fine leg for a run.
A short delivery which has been mistimed by the batsman to square leg.
ASGHAR STANIKZAI, the captain comes out to bat.

OUT! That is the third one down for Afghanistan. The short ball plan has worked. Gabriel bowls it on the body of the batsman who looks to pull but gets a top edge and is caught by Jason Mohammed at square leg. The batsman waits and looks around but the umpire gives him out. Shah is not happy with the decision as he feels it had not taken an edge but he has to go. Afghanistan are in deep trouble here. They need to build a partnership to steady the ship.
Short leg now in place for the batsman.
Pitches it short, Shah defends it off the back foot.
Bowls a well-directed short ball, Shah does well to duck under it.
Shorter in length, Shenwari goes to pull but gets it off the glove for a run on the leg side.
Bowls it shorter in length, Shenwari chops it onto the ground.
SAMIULLAH SHENWARI strides out to the middle.

OUT! Where were you running? A big confusion there between the batsmen.  Holder bowls it on a length on the stumps,  Rahmat Shah tucks it on the leg side, he calls for a single, Ahmadi sets off but is sent back half-way down. Lewis at mid-wicket just picks the ball and lobs it back to Holder who takes the bails off. There was never a run. Afghanistan lose two in quick time.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Bowls it on a length on the stumps, Ahmadi tucks it on the leg side towards mid-wicket for a run.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Ahmadi lets it through.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Batsman does not offer a shot.
Shorter length on off, Shah gets an outside edge down to thrid man for a run.
RAHMAT SHAH is the next man in.

OUT! The captain strikes! His tight bowling has paid off. Bowls it short on the stumps. Zadran tries to work it on the leg side but gets a top edge and lobs to Holder who takes an easy catch. He is all pumped up as he gets the first wicket, just like he did in the first game.
Shorter in length on off, Ahmadi defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Ahmadi plays it off the front foot.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Slight delay. SHANNON GABRIEL is catching his right leg.
Back of a length outside off, Ahmadi is not interested in playing a shot.
Back of a length on off, Zadran plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
Short aimed at the body of the batsman, the batsman pulls it to the left of fine leg. Chase makes good ground and does well to push it inside in play. They run a single.
Length ball outside off, Zadran lets it go to the keeper. Maiden there by Jason.
Consistent lines here from Jason. Hurls it on a length outside off, Zadran lets it through to the keeper.
Full swinging away from the stumps, Zadran is not interested in playing a shot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Zadran lets it through to the keeper.
Bowls it way outside off, Zadran shoulders arm's to it.
Full and way outside off, the batsman lets it go through to the keeper. That ball looked a certain wide but the umpire did not feel so.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. This was quite an eventful over.
WIDE! Bowls it short down the leg side, Ahmadi tries to tickle it down the leg side but misses it and it is signaled a wide.

Big appeal for caught behind but the umpire gives it not out. The bowler bowls it short and the ball keeps coming in with the angle. Ahmadi tries to evade it but the ball hits him on the arm and goes to the keeper. That was a good ball there.
Back of a length on off, Ahmadi defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Just wide of the diving filder at covers. Bowls it on a length outside off, Ahmadi drives it on the up. The ball goes uppishly past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Bowls it shorter in length angling in towards the batsman, Ahmadi jumps and defends it onto the ground. Gabriel got some good bounce there.
Lands it on a length on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Drifts on the pads, Zadran flicks it behind square leg for a couple. Good running by the batsmen.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, the batsman goes for a flick but misses and the umpire calls it a wide.
Bowls it full on the pads, Ahmadi tries to flick it but misses it. The ball hits the pads and rolls on the leg side they run through for a leg bye.
Back of a length outside off, Ahmadi leaves it alone.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Ahmadi lets it through to the keeper.
BEATEN! Holder gets lovely shape away from the batsman. Bowls it on a length outside off, Ahmadi pokes at it and gets beaten.
Bowls it wide outside off, Ahmadi lets the ball through to the keeper. That was very wide lucky not to be called one.
Wide outside off, left alone. Could have been wided.

Full and wide outside off, JA looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge  which flies between first slip and third slip to third man! Why wasn't there a second slip in place? He would have gobbled it up! A single taken. Sometimes captains get too cheeky with their field placements.
He just can't resist that shot, can he? Gabriel keeps it short and wide outside off, Ahmadi slashes hard but misses again.
On a good length outside off, Javed hops in his crease and blocks.
Short and wide outside off, Ahmadi slashes and misses. He was out in a similar fashion on Friday.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and wide outside off, JA drives it sweetly through the covers. Mid off gets around and puts in a valiant dive to save runs. Just a single taken.
Short again, this time Ahmadi mistimes his cut towards cover-point.
Short in length, outside off, played towards point.
WIDE. Another massive wide, way outside off, left alone.

SAFE! But a good fielding effort from Lewis. Once again, miscommunciation from the two batsmen. This one nips back in from outside off, but slants down the leg side. Ahmadi misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. There is an LBW appeal which the umpire is not interested in and meanwhile, Ahmadi sets off for a single blindly. However, this time Noor Ali is not interested and sends him back. Evin Lewis quickly gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end and this time he hits. It is referred upstairs and replays show that Ahmadi's slide has saved him.
Run out appeal! JAVED AHMADI has dived in but has the direct hit caught him short? Referred upstairs...

Fuller around off, coming in, Ahmadi works it towards short mid-wicket. He sets off for a single but then sends his partner back. Noor Ali is gone for all money but Evin Lewis misses his shy at the bowler's end.
WIDE. Miles outside off, very wide, Javed shoulders arms.
On a good length outside off, shouldered arms to.
JASON HOLDER will bowl with the second new ball. He has one slip in place.

FOUR! CLASSY! First boundary of the day. It is a half volley outside off and Noor Ali leans into it. Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through the covers. The ball slows down near the ropes and Jason Holder gets to it from mid off but at the last moment, is lazy in bending and touches the ball after it meets the ropes. Himself signals a boundary to the umpire.
Good bounce and movement, from outside off, punched towards point. A single taken.

This one jags back in a long way, from back of a length, outside off, Ahmadi looks to punch it through the off side but is beaten as the ball comes in a long way. It continues to keep moving and Shai Hope has to dive full length to his left to stop the ball.
Around off and outside, steered to third man for a single. Afghanistan are up and running.
Keeps it on a fuller length this time, just around off, Zadran is squared up as he comes forward to defend but manages to keep the ball out.
A fine yorker around off, Noor Ali digs it out to the off side.

The players and the umpires have walked out to the middle. NOOR ALI and JAVED AHMADI will open the batting for Afghanistan. SHANNON GABRIEL will bowl with first new ball and he has two slips in place.

PITCH REPORT - Jeffrey Dujon doing the pitch report says they are playing on the same pitch they played on two days ago but he feels it looks different. He reckons there is even covering of grass today. He opines it looks a firm surface. He admits the ball might not come on that easy and might not be that easy to bat on. Ends by saying Afghanistan's decision to bat first is the right one.

JASON HOLDER says he would have batted first as well. He opines it is a good wicket and he feels the it won't change much. He informs they had a good discussion and a good practice session yesterday. Informs they have one change today Rovman Powell comes in for Miguel Cummins.

ASGHAR STANIKZAI says he would like to bat first. Feels the wicket is  dry and might take some spin. Adds that he felt they had a good total last time as the outfield here is quite slow. Informs they have an unchanged team.
TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and opt to bat first. They are unchanged and West Indies make one change, they bring in Rovman Powell for Miguel Cummins.

The hosts, on the other hand, would want to pick themselves up and turn the tables around today.  A loss today would dampen their chances of automatic qualification for the World Cup 2019. They were quite disciplined with the ball but would want a better outing from their young and dynamic batting line-up. The Caribbean side would want to win today's game and level the series. Stay tuned for the toss.

Welcome to the second ODI between West Indies and Afghanistan at the Darren Sammy National Cricket Stadium. The visitors caused a huge upset in the first game by beating the hosts quite convincingly. Rashid Khan the teenage sensation ran through the Windies batting line up. The side from the subcontinent had  a decent outing with the bat on a slow and a low pitch. The victory in the last game would have boosted their morale. The Afghans would want to continue their form in this game. A victory here would clinch the series for them.
